title: SCIM reconciliation: batch atomicity, partial-failure compaction and audit enrichment for orphan detection
creator: Asha Kumar
description: Background: Customer incidents show intermittent partial success when applying SCIM change batches (e.g., 10 user create/update commands in a single request) to some enterprise IdPs. Partial successes lead to inconsistent state between Redwood and customer IdP: orphaned accounts, duplicate groups, and unclear audit trails. This ticket implements a reconciliation-first approach: make batched SCIM changes optionally atomic-at-logical-grouping, add post-batch compaction to surface partial failures, enrich audit events with SAML assertion metadata, and add deterministic jittered-backoff retries with idempotency tokens. Goal: reduce customer-visible orphan accounts and provide incident-grade audit trails for compliance teams.
acceptance_criteria: Config flag 'atomic_batching' can be toggled per-tenant and per-connector (default: false).
When 'atomic_batching' is enabled, batch partial failures must be rolled back locally and retried as a whole or split deterministically into sub-batches based on provider response codes.
All SCIM provisioning events recorded in audit logs include: request_id, tenant_id, connector_id, original_saml_nameid if available, and per-object idempotency token.
Reconciliation job identifies orphaned accounts within a configurable grace window and emits a flagged audit event with rationale and last-seen sequence id.
Retry policy uses exponential backoff with randomized jitter. Retries are bounded and observable via metrics.
Unit + integration tests cover success, partial-failure, and rollback paths using a SCIM test harness (mock IdP).
Dashboard shows per-tenant partial-failure rate, orphan detection rate, and retry success ratio.
design_decisions: Use optimistic commit with per-batch idempotency token (UUID) stored in provisioning ledger to detect duplicate/reordered deliveries.
Implement 'compaction' step: after a batch returns partial failures, extract failed item IDs, create a deterministic retry plan that respects provider retry-after headers and error semantics.
Do not attempt strict two-phase commit across external IdPs. Instead prefer local rollback (tombstone created locally and queued) and reconcilers for eventual consistency with strong audit signals.
Enrich audit events with extracted SAML attributes where present to link provisioning actions back to identity assertions for compliance requests.
Expose per-tenant configuration to enable safe rollout. Default stays backward compatible (atomic batching off).
implementation_steps: Schema: add 'idempotency_token' and 'original_saml' columns to scim_provisioning_log table (migration + backfill plan).
API: extend provisioning API to accept optional idempotency_token and batch-level atomic flag. Validate and persist token before dispatch.
Runtime: implement batch dispatcher that can detect partial failures and build compaction retry queue (respecting per-item error codes).
Reconciler: extend existing reconciliation worker to mark 'zombie/orphan' accounts when last_successful_seq < threshold and emit audit event with rationale.
Retries: implement library util for exponential backoff with jitter and honoring 'Retry-After' response header. Add metrics around retries/latency/errors.
Audit: wire enriched fields into existing audit-log sink, ensure logs are structured JSON with required fields for downstream retention and searchability.
Tests: add unit tests for ledger idempotency, integration tests against scim-mock that simulates partial success, and e2e test for orphan detection.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary, 1% tenants): enable atomic_batching=false by default, start emitting enriched audit events for all batches to the audit sink.
Phase 2 (10% tenants): enable compaction/retry queue but keep atomic batching disabled; monitor partial-failure rate and retry success.
Phase 3 (opt-in customers): allow toggling atomic_batching=true for customers who request stronger guarantees; observe for 48h for regression.
Phase 4: if stable, flip default to provide stronger guidance and documentation; ensure runbook updated.
monitoring_and_alerting: Metric: scim.batch.partial_failure_rate by tenant/connector (>0.5% triggers warning).
Alert: orphan_detection_rate spike (increase > 3x baseline) -> P0 oncall.
Audit dashboard panel: recent SCIM batches with failed_item_ids and original_saml.nameid for compliance triage.
SLOs: add a dashboard to ensure reconciliation closes within configured grace window for 99% of cases.
